about: Ordinary exchanges: no pony should shove Anon for any of these (W2-SHOVE-PATCH, M-MOD-12). Fields: pony replies; said = Anon's line (age seconds ago, to `current`, default the pony); listener (default player); mood/thought/friendship/romance = her impression for this reply (impression false = none); note = a stored older impression; blush; proactive; touch.

cases.said: Fluttershy asked about music
cases.reply: Oh, did she? I've been meaning to lend her my songbook.
cases.thought: He keeps up with our friends, that's sweet.

cases.said: I'll be there shortly
cases.reply: Yay! I'll save you a cupcake!

cases.said: How's your day going?
cases.reply: Ugh, Spike knocked over my whole bookshelf again. That's enough chaos for one day.
cases.thought: Spike needs to be more careful with my books.

cases.said: What's the plot of that novel?
cases.reply: A daring explorer searches a lost temple. You'd love it!

cases.said: Can you press that button for me?
cases.reply: Sure thing, sugarcube.

cases.said: What do you mean by that?
cases.reply: I mean the weather team is behind schedule, that's all.
cases.thought: He seems puzzled about the weather.

cases.said: I'm plotting out a vegetable garden
cases.reply: Well, ain't that nice! Plant some carrots.

cases.said: How are your chickens doing?
cases.reply: Oh, they're wonderful! Elizabeak laid three eggs today.

cases.said: Want some butter for the pancakes?
cases.reply: Yes please! Extra butter!

cases.said: Those dresses are stunning
cases.reply: W-why, thank you, darling! You flatter me.

cases.said: I helped Big Mac with the harvest
cases.reply: Well, shucks, that's mighty kind of ya.

cases.said: I forgot to bring your book back, sorry.
cases.reply: Oh. That's a little disappointing, but okay.
cases.thought: I hope he remembers next time.

cases.said: What happened to the pond?
cases.reply: Discord turned it into lemonade! I'm so mad right now!
cases.thought: Discord went way too far this time.

cases.said: You look really nice today
cases.reply: O-oh! Th-thank you...
Good morning! Lovely weather, isn't it?

note.thought: He was rude to me earlier.

cases.reply: Quit it, Applejack, you're hogging the mirror!

cases.said: Do we have enough flour for the cake?
cases.reply: Hey! Of course we do, silly!

cases.said: Come closer, I want to show you something
cases.reply: Huh? Okay, what is it?

cases.said: This feels so familiar
cases.reply: Deja vu? I've read about that!

cases.said: Let's step back and look at the whole meadow
cases.reply: Oh my, it's so beautiful from here.

cases.said: Did you see the Wonderbolts' shortcut over the lake?
cases.reply: Did I?! It was totally awesome!

cases.said: Could you pass the buttercups?
cases.reply: Here ya go.

cases.said: I bought marshmallows for cocoa
cases.reply: Ooh! Cocoa party!

cases.said: I lifted dumbbells at the gym today
cases.reply: My, how very athletic of you.

cases.said: The ugly duckling story is my favourite
cases.reply: Oh, that one has such a lovely ending.

cases.said: Are the butterflies out today?
cases.reply: Yes! Dozens of them in the garden.

cases.said: Shorts weather today, huh?
cases.reply: Ha! Pegasi don't need shorts.

cases.said: I'm meaning to visit the library more
cases.reply: You're always welcome there!

cases.said: Excuse me, can I get past?
cases.reply: Oopsie, sorry!

cases.said: What are you up to?
cases.reply: Ugh, Scootaloo begged me for flying lessons again. Enough already!
cases.thought: That kid never quits, it's getting annoying.

cases.said: Want to go shopping?
cases.reply: Excuse me? Of course I do, darling!

cases.said: Angel looks grumpy
cases.reply: Oh, Angel, please stop throwing carrots at the window!

cases.said: Meanwhile, the train is late
cases.reply: Again? Honestly, the schedule is a mess.
cases.thought: The train company is so annoying.

cases.said: Is the party still on?
cases.reply: Nope, the Cakes cancelled it. Boo.

cases.said: I watched the race yesterday
cases.reply: Then you saw that cheater Lightning Dust! How dare she!

cases.said: Can I help with the fence?
cases.reply: Nah, I got it, but thank ya kindly.

cases.said: Is the button on this machine broken?
cases.reply: Hmm, let me take a look.

cases.said: Is that a mockingbird?
cases.reply: Oh yes! Isn't her song lovely?

cases.said: The new shop window looks bold
cases.reply: Bold is exactly what I was going for!

cases.said: Are you nervous about the show?
cases.reply: N-nervous? Me? Never!

cases.said: I'm short on bits this week
cases.reply: Aww, I'll lend you some!

cases.said: I think a dragon is closer than we thought
cases.reply: A dragon?! We should warn the town.

cases.said: Granny Smith told me a joke
cases.reply: Heh, she's a real hoot, ain't she?

cases.said: Did Sweetie Belle finish her song?
cases.reply: Not yet, and she keeps singing it at midnight! Honestly, enough is enough.

cases.said: Discord says hello
cases.reply: Oh, Discord, please don't turn my cottage upside down again...
cases.thought: He crossed the line last time.

cases.said: Let's make tea
cases.reply: Wonderful! I'll get the good teaspoons.

cases.said: Who runs the drama club?
cases.reply: Rarity! She's such a drama queen about it, hehe.

cases.said: Did Gilda visit?
cases.reply: Yeah, and she was a total jerk to Fluttershy. Not cool.

cases.said: The apples smell great
cases.reply: Picked 'em fresh this mornin'.

cases.said: I'll be back in a short while
cases.reply: Okay, I'll be here with the bunnies.
